messages:
Samira Khan: FYI planning a joint demo for the cloud marketplace featuring our 'bring-your-own-key' flow + SAML SSO. Need partner access to a sandbox and KMS/HSM endpoint.

Partner-Integration-Rep: We can stand up a PKCS#11 endpoint and provide SCIM test tokens. We'll also share HSM signing cert and rotation script.

Tom Reed: Good. Primary checklist: 1) SAML metadata exchange and signed AuthnRequests 2) SCIM delta sync and rate-limit handling 3) KMS encrypt/decrypt + key rotation test 4) Secrets manager push/pull with proper ACLs.

Ibrahim Hassan: For SAML, make sure our SP supports AssertionConsumerService POST and we validate Audience + Recipient. I'll prepare a quick metadata file.

Nina Gomez: Marketing asked for embargoed assets. Proposed timeline: test pass by 11/03, dry-run 11/05, public announcement 11/10. Legal needs to review data flow diagram before 11/04.

InfraBot: Infra ticket created: INF-5192. Provisioning request: 2x private VMs + hsm-proxy. ETA 48 hours.

Samira Khan: Add a failover plan: if partner HSM unavailable, fallback to software-wrapped keys in our vault with a note in demo. Can't expose fallback in announcement though.

Partner-Integration-Rep: Understood. We'll supply a short runbook for rotation and for simulated HSM outage.

Tom Reed: Test cases to add: SCIM create/update/delete, SCIM delta token resume, SAML replays (reject), KMS key destroy/restore simulation, secrets sync conflict resolution. Also validate audit log entries for each action.

Ibrahim Hassan: For KMS, ensure our envelope keys and partner CMK handshake are covered. We'll need partner public key and cert chain.

Nina Gomez: I'll handle press embargo dates and coordinate with partner PR. Please mark any customer-identifying screenshots as scrubbed.

Samira Khan: Ok action items: Ibrahim prepare SAML/SP metadata; Tom draft test matrix and include audit checks; Partner rep share PKCS#11 endpoint + rotation script; InfraBot follow up INF-5192. Weekly check-in scheduled Thurs 9am PT.

Partner-Integration-Rep: Confirmed on deliverables. Thanks all :thumbsup:

InfraBot: INF-5192 status updated to 'provisioned' at 4898761248.
